lines: #If the junk food is on the counter, you'll *eat* it.
If the phone is next to your bed, you'll *scroll.*
If the gym bag is buried in the closet, you'll *skip.*
It's because your environment is *stronger* than your willpower.
#So stop trying to fight your surroundings.
#Put the phone in another room at *night.*
Put the fruit where the snacks *used* to be.
Delete the apps that *steal* your hours.
Put the savings where you can't *see* them.
They just built a life where they don't have to *fight* as much.
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.

post.title: Willpower Is Overrated. Do This Instead.
post.caption: Make the good choice the easy choice. Design your space. 🏠
post.first_comment: What's one change you'll make to your space today? 👇
